name: Amnesia
source:
A short visual novel following the path of two people who wake up in a forest trying to figure out who they are, where they are, and how to get wherever home is.
[From [url=https://skipsman.itch.io/amnesia-demo] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇视觉小说，讲述两个人在森林中醒来，试图弄清自己是谁、身处何方，以及如何回到所谓的家。

（来源：[url=https://skipsman.itch.io/amnesia-demo]itch.io[/url]）
